instruction: 补充更新 并重新发布
instruction_context: 用户在OpenAI域名联网审计后授权更新并重新发布。按审计建议补入已确认的WorkOS精确域名，刷新官方证据，openai.org保留为未选候选；提交、推送并通过既有GitHub Release/Latest渠道发布v0.1.6。
limitations: Publish this validated batch through the existing GitHub Release/Latest distribution channel; preserve previous releases and tags.
Bind committed inputs and two reproducible release builds to the reviewed candidate bytes; complete native, regression, fixed-download and empty-cache validation before switching Latest.
This instruction does not authorize direct remote-device configuration changes or restarts and does not attest authenticated product functionality or production deployment.
